'''Viirsun''' were a small ground [[Bird/Legends|bird]] with drab, brown and black feathers. They could be found in [[Darth Malgus's family estate|Veradun's Family Estate]].

==Biology and Appearance==
Viirsun were a small ground bird with brown and black feathers, they ate insects that were regurgitated from the mouth of their mother. A juvenile Viirsun was almost indistinguishable from a young [[Mimnil]]. The [[Mimnil]] exploited this fact, killing young Viirsun and replacing them. Once they began to molt, they would attack and kill their adoptive mother.<ref name="The Third Lesson" />

==Behavior==
It was common for the [[Gender/Legends|male]] Viirsun to leave the nest after the birth of its offspring.<ref name="The Third Lesson" />
